name: asarel-claude-skills
description: Skills and mods for Claude Code sessions

plugins.name: model-policy
plugins.description: Opus runs only in the main session. Subagents run on Sonnet at most, and on Haiku for lookups and mechanical edits.

plugins.name: session-monitor
plugins.description: Sidebar pane showing the folder, branch and model, subagents, subscription usage, context fill, cost and session time, and the model-policy tally when that mod is installed.

plugins.name: session-coach
plugins.description: Suggests /clear when a prompt starts a new task, and budgets workflow agents.
